evaluation_system_002.answer: Classroom Teacher Evaluation System (CTES); Marzano Evaluation Model
evaluation_system_002.evidence: The Parties agree that the primary purpose of the Classroom Teacher Evaluation System (CTES) is to provide employees with a framework to improve instruction... The Parties have agreed to use the Marzano Evaluation Model.
